<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, peaks in the typical methyl carbon region (≈10‑30 ppm) are at 24.56, 19.40, and 16.60 ppm (three alkyl methyls). Additional downfield methyl carbons attached to heteroatoms appear at 57.20 ppm (O‑CH₃) and at 41.00 ppm and 39.20 ppm (likely N‑CH₃ groups). Each distinct peak corresponds to a separate CH₃ carbon, giving a total of six methyl groups.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
